nancy-pearlman.text: Advocates equal pay and opportunities for faculty, noting "over 65% of faculty are part-timers."
Says she advocated designated parking lots at all nine colleges for unhoused students, plus restrooms and shower facilities.

Says the district should "reestablish" its position as a nationwide leader in sustainable building practices; supports renewable energy, water reuse, open space, toxics reduction, recycling, heat-island mitigation and mass transit on campuses.
Says "student success is critical" and services should be available so students excel and have good transfer opportunities.
Says she won her first election in 2001 spending under $1,000 and emphasizes educating voters over fundraising.
Endorsed by Americans for Democratic Action of Southern California and Progressive Democrats of the Santa Monica Mountains.

darryn-harris.text: Says the district must take "seriously the need for affordable housing so students can stay enrolled, succeed, and build stable futures."

source.title: Darryn Harris for LA Community College Board - Meet Darryn

darryn-harris.text: Says LACCD colleges should "serve students, support faculty and staff, and connect more people to the skills they need" and calls them pathways to good jobs and economic mobility.

source.title: Darryn Harris for LA Community College Board - Meet Darryn

elaine-alaniz.text: On her 2026 County Supervisor campaign site: her approach is to protect communities from the fentanyl crisis and manage public resources responsibly "so families are not forced to shoulder ever increasing tax burdens."

source.title: Elaine Alaniz campaign site (LA County Board of Supervisors District 1, 2026; not her LACCD campaign)

elaine-alaniz.text: On her County Supervisor site: wants homelessness programs tied to measurable outcomes so taxpayer dollars help people "transition back into stability and independence."

source.title: Elaine Alaniz campaign site (LA County Board of Supervisors District 1, 2026; not her LACCD campaign)

elaine-alaniz.text: On her County Supervisor site: proposes expanding workforce training through community-college partnerships and supporting apprenticeship programs in skilled trades.

source.title: Elaine Alaniz campaign site (LA County Board of Supervisors District 1, 2026; not her LACCD campaign)

elaine-alaniz.text: On her County Supervisor site: calls for fiscal discipline and policies that support economic opportunity "without increasing the tax burden on residents."

source.title: Elaine Alaniz campaign site (LA County Board of Supervisors District 1, 2026; not her LACCD campaign)

jason-r-aula.text: Writes "I believe in small government, free enterprise and individual liberty," and says his political beliefs are guided by the U.S. Constitution.

source.title: Jason R. Aula - Meet the Candidate (legacy page, header references a 2024 Assembly campaign)

jason-r-aula.text: Says funding higher education is of utmost importance and "all levels of education need more money to update technology and hire more teachers."

source.title: Jason R. Aula - Meet the Candidate (legacy page, header references a 2024 Assembly campaign)

jason-r-aula.text: Pledges to usher in solar and wind power for LACCD campuses and facilities, and to reinstate and fund the Pierce College Farm.

source.title: Jason R. Aula - Meet the Candidate (legacy page, header references a 2024 Assembly campaign)
